name: Dana Point Youth Board
what_you_do: Help at city events like Trunk or Treat and Egg Hunts. You meet to talk about issues that matter to local teens. You help get more young people into community life.
who_can_apply: High school age teens who live in Dana Point.
pay_detail: The program page does not mention pay.
duration: Six meetings, Oct 21, 2026 to April 21, 2027. Third Wednesday, 4:30 to 6:00 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 form is posted, but no deadline is listed. The first meeting was Oct 21, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the 2026-27 form on the program page. List two references who are not family. A parent signs if you are under 18. Send it to the City Clerk at ssharke@danapoint.org or 33282 Golden Lantern, Suite 203.
notes: The page does not say if seats are still open this year, so call (949) 248-3500 first. Meetings are in the City Council Chambers. There is no meeting on Dec 16, 2026.
